name: gitroot-chokepoint-and-grep-contract
title: Single resolveGitCwd choke-point + grep-contract test to kill the wrapper-root git-cwd defect class
description: Make resolveGitCwd (already exported from packages/main/src/core/story-signed-workspace-resolution.ts:195) the SOLE entry point for resolving git child-process cwd, and add a grep-based contract smoke that FAILS if any new git call site (execFileSync/spawnSync/execSync of 'git') bypasses it by passing a bare metadataRoot/projectRoot as cwd. The defect class — git child-process cwds defaulted to metadataRoot but the wrapper-root layout's real git repo is a configured gitRoot subdir — has hit at least 3 prior stories (B-1637 doctor probes, B-e791 INIT git-readiness guidance, B-0740 doctor --repair + lint change-scoping), each whack-a-mole fixing one or two specific call sites without preventing recurrence. The current state: 193 git child-process calls across 88 files; only ~14 sites are rerouted via resolveGitCwd; the existing gitroot-cwd-routing-smoke and bare-gate-gitroot-cwd-smoke assert the SPECIFIC rerouted sites but do not prevent a new call site from being added with the bare projectRoot cwd. This story (a) audits all 193 sites and reroutes the unrouted ones through resolveGitCwd, (b) adds a contract grep test that fails CI on any new `(execFileSync|spawnSync|execSync)\(['"]git['"]` with bare projectRoot/root/metadataRoot cwd not going through the helper. Out of scope: the smoke-runner consolidation effort (proposed #2 — separate sub-program).
